title: A bill to designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 278 Main Street in Chadron, Nebraska, as the "Sergeant Cory Mracek Memorial Post Office".
official_summary:
(This measure has not been amended since it was introduced. The summary of that version is repeated here.)

Designates the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 278 Main Street in Chadron, Nebraska, as the "Sergeant Cory Mracek Memorial Post Office."

summary.headline: A 2014 law names the Chadron, Nebraska post office the Sergeant Cory Mracek Memorial Post Office.
summary.what_it_does: This law renames a United States Postal Service building at 278 Main Street in Chadron, Nebraska. The new name honors Sergeant Cory Mracek. It does not change how the post office operates or what services it offers.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on November 26, 2014, and the renaming took effect on that date.
